images.caption: This is where the first Fire Station of Glendale, Arizona was located. The structure is located in N. 57th Drive and was built in 1912. It was later used as the town's municipal court and is now occupied by the Glendale Information Technology.

images.caption: The Two Story Adobe House was built in 1918 and is located at 6738 N. 54th Drive in Glendale, Arizona. It is the largest adobe building in Glendale and listed as historical by the “Glendale Historic Building Survey”.

images.caption: This historic building was built in the early 1900s and is located at 6725 N 57th Dr. in Glendale, Arizona. The Glendale Welding Company, which was established in 1937, claims to be Glendale’s oldest business in one location. The building is listed in the “Glendale Historic Building Survey” of 1980.

images.caption: The Glendale Tract Community Center was built in 1937 and is located at the axial terminus of Sands Road on a large parcel that occupies the Southeast corner of the historic district. It is with the Historic Glendale Tract Community District listed in the National Register of Historic Places on January 11, 2006, reference #05001506.
